items.html: However, the last Sefira of the six Sefirot of Yetzira is called Malchut de Yetzira, Nukva de ZA de Yetzira which is now the sixth Sefira of Olam Beria. This is the meaning of Ever ha Yarden, the place of the children of Gad and the children of Reuben. It is considered Malchut of the past Yetzira with all first three of the past Assiya, which are now the four bottom Sefirot de Beria.
